description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between reliability score and cost for three different models: the 3-Model Ensemble, the 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis, labeled "Cost," ranges from 0 to 10 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," ranges from 30 to 90 on a linear scale, with horizontal gridlines at intervals of 10. The 3-Model Ensemble is represented by a blue line with circular markers, which starts at a reliability score of approximately 77 when the cost is 0 and decreases to about 73 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble is shown as a red line with circular markers, beginning at a reliability score of around 78 at a cost of 0 and declining to approximately 72 at a cost of 10. The GPT-4 model is depicted by a yellow line with circular markers, starting at a reliability score of about 89 at a cost of 0, decreasing to roughly 67 at a cost of 5, and continuing to fall to approximately 35 at a cost of 10. All three lines exhibit a downward trend, indicating that reliability score decreases as cost increases.
